correctness.rationale: All-size k>=2, m>=0 moment formulas derive from exactly k additional faces per insertion, A count updates by k-1 and shared B count updates by k-2. The mixed and square-moment recurrences solve by finite products; R_j=mu_j^2/(M_j beta_j) starts >1 and grows because (M_j+k-1)^2-(M_j+k)(M_j+k-2)=1, so the covariance is strictly negative for every m>=1. Gamma-product asymptotics and summable strictly signed innovation series establish nonzero negative and positive scaling constants and the k=2 limiting correlation. Independently enumerated actual graph histories and exact rational tests passed 2645 assertions; no finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Degree correlation of original clique vertices probes how early topology co-develops, distinct from the known one-vertex power law. Even though vertices can attach simultaneously and one history yields strictly positive conditional co-attachment covariance, all-size unconditional covariance is strictly negative; its nonvanishing macroscopic correlation quantifies structural dependence. The general all-k formula and sharp k=2 value are motivated stochastic-network phenomena rather than an arbitrary finite count.
